title: Chat interop facade: SSE reframe + toolcall coalescer for OpenAI ChatCompletions compatibility
creator: Maya Chen
description: Implement a lightweight facade that maps OpenAI Chat Completions (v1/streaming) request/response shapes into Redwood's internal conversational protocol while preserving semantics for function/tool calling and structured outputs. The facade will: 1) Normalize incoming OA messages (roles, content, name) to Redwood schema and attach idempotency keys when provided; 2) Reframe SSE-style streaming chunks from OA into Redwood EventStream frames with deterministic chunk boundaries and reassembly IDs; 3) Coalesce sequential function_call partials into a single canonical tool invocation payload for downstream tool runners, while preserving partial outputs as provisional events; 4) Validate structured output blocks against provided JSON-schema/structure hints and emit structured_parsing signals; 5) Provide retry semantics that are idempotent for side-effecting tool calls, with a configurable safe-retry window and explicit failover to non-invocation fallback responses; 6) Surface compatibility telemetry (compat_layer_version, original_request_hash, mapping_latency_ms) and preserve provenance headers for audit logs.
acceptance_criteria: Facade accepts OA ChatCompletions request (sync and streaming) and returns responses with token-level event parity for first 8 tokens compared to reference mapping harness
SSE-to-EventStream framing test: reassembled messages match non-streamed baseline in 1000 fuzzed message cases
Function/tool call coalescer produces a single canonical tool invocation payload when OA emits function_call across multiple stream chunks
Structured output validator flags schema mismatches and attaches structured_parsing:false events without dropping the primary content
Idempotency and retry tests: duplicate requests with same idempotency key are handled exactly-once for side-effecting tool runners in integration test harness
Instrumentation: mapping latency, mapping errors, and toolcall_coalesce_count emitted to the console metrics dashboard and alert if error rate > 0.5% over 5m during canary
implementation_notes: Create a new service module: chat-interop-facade (Go) behind existing compat routing layer
Stream reframe: implement chunk sequencer with reassembly ID, using existing sse-helpers library; add backpressure signals to gateway
Toolcall coalescer: state machine keyed by conversation+request hash, windowed assembly (default 2s), configurable by route
Schema enforcer: reuse evals-schema lib and emit structured_parsing events but do not block main token stream unless strict mode enabled
Telemetry: add compat_layer_version tag, request_hash, map_latency_ms; create Grafana dashboard panel for facade mapping errors
Add integration tests in redwood/integration/compat-tests with recorded OA fixtures and mock tool-runner that verifies single invocation semantics
